page.title: Connect Telzyra to your tools
page.description: Telzyra is in early access. Core building blocks come first, and app connectors are released step by step. Every connector below shows its real status.

notice: No third-party connector is live yet. Until a connector is released, you can reach most services through webhooks and HTTP requests.

universal.title: Works with any API
universal.description: Use the Webhook trigger and the HTTP Request action to connect services that don't have a dedicated connector yet.

request.title: Missing an app?
request.description: Tell us which integration matters most to your team. Requests help us decide what to build next.
